preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 2 <= n <= 300000 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case n is an integer between 2 and 3*10^5 inclusive.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 3*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line, n in zip(output_lines, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Every integer in the output is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == len(line.split()) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: All integers in each output line are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all((max(nums) - min(nums)) ** 2 == sum(nums) for nums in (list(map(int, line.split())) for line in output_lines))
postconditions.description: For each sequence, the square of the difference between the maximum and minimum equals the sum of the sequence.
